definition: a shelter of cloth stretched over poles
description: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.
